response.text:
I can’t see your support system, so I can’t compute it for you. Here’s a quick, practical way to get a ballpark and some examples you can drop into a deck.

How to estimate (fast)
- Confirm the date range (by calendar quarter — e.g., “last quarter” = Q2 2026 if you mean Apr–Jun 2026).
- Search your ticketing tool for SSO-related tags/terms: SSO, single sign-on, SAML, OAuth, Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, “login via”, “cannot SSO”, “SSO error”, “auth redirect”, etc. Use tags/fields if you tag tickets by issue type — that’s more accurate.
- Count SSO tickets and total tickets for the quarter, then compute: SSO_share = SSO_tickets / Total_tickets.
- If you’re worried about misses, take a random sample of ~200 subject/bodies and check false negatives; scale accordingly.

Quick Excel/Sheets formulas
- If column A is created date and column B is subject/body/tags:
  - Total for quarter: =COUNTIFS(A:A,">=2026-04-01",A:A,"<=2026-06-30")
  - SSO matches (simple keyword example): =SUM( COUNTIFS(A:A,">=2026-04-01",A:A,"<=2026-06-30",B:B,{"*SSO*","*SAML*","*Okta*","*Azure AD*","*single sign-on*"}) )
  - Share = SSO_count / Total_count

Example ballpark numbers (illustrative only)
- If you had 2,000 tickets and ~100 SSO tickets → ~5%
- If you had 5,000 tickets and ~250 SSO tickets → ~5%
- If you had 1,000 tickets and ~30 SSO tickets → ~3%

Suggested deck wording
- “Approximately 4–6% of support tickets last quarter were SSO-related (estimate based on keyword/tag search).”
- Add a confidence note if needed: “(ballpark; may undercount tickets without explicit SSO keywords)”

If you want, paste the total ticket count and the SSO-ticket count (or export a small CSV) and I’ll compute the exact percent and a one-line slide phrase for you.
